quarterly_data.quarter: Roche-Genentech press release: Roche announces grand opening of its Innovation Center (09-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Roche opened the Roche Genentech Innovation Center Boston at Harvard's Enterprise Research Campus in Allston as its Cardiovascular, Renal and Metabolism (CVRM) hub, bringing together discovery research, clinical development, artificial intelligence and data science specialists in an end-to-end R&D environment. Roche and Genentech signed a 10-year lease for the 95,000 square foot centre, with capacity for up to 500 people. It is part of Roche and Genentech's USD 50 billion investment in US manufacturing and R&D, following Holly Springs, North Carolina and Hillsboro, Oregon; the companies have around 25,000 US employees, 15 R&D centers and 13 manufacturing sites.
